query:
UPDATE jobs
        SET
            status = $3,
            run_after = COALESCE($4, run_after),
            lease_owner = NULL,
            leased_at = NULL,
            heartbeat_at = NULL,
            last_error = $5,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
          AND lease_owner = $2
          AND status = 'leased'
